entry_boundary.action_routing: accept exactly the first terminal action only through one shared authority: owned edit WM_KEYDOWN while foreground and edit-focused, or synchronous exact owned WM_COMMAND/BN_CLICKED parent and button HWND while foreground and that button-focused; sent button commands observed during PeekMessage precede its returned queued message; Submit maps only to submit and Cancel maps only to cancel; never poll global key state
entry_boundary.terminal_behavior: submit returns only non-secret success or typed error; cancel, close, timeout, and exception clear mutable buffers, clear and destroy the control on its owning UI thread, join the thread, and return only cancelled or typed error
